both 31-day presence and weighted 183-day sum must hold together for substantial presence test.
ocaml:
(* 7701(b)(3)(A)(i) — presence requirement for current year *)
let meets_31_day_requirement (days_current_year : int) : bool =
  days_current_year >= 31

(* 7701(b)(3)(A)(ii) — weighted 3-year day count *)
let weighted_day_count (days_current_year : int) (days_1st_preceding_year : int) (days_2nd_preceding_year : int) : float =
  (float_of_int days_current_year *. 1.0) +.
  (float_of_int days_1st_preceding_year /. 3.0) +.
  (float_of_int days_2nd_preceding_year /. 6.0)

let meets_weighted_183_day_requirement (days_current_year : int) (days_1st_preceding_year : int) (days_2nd_preceding_year : int) : bool =
  weighted_day_count days_current_year days_1st_preceding_year days_2nd_preceding_year >= 183.0

(* 7701(b)(3)(A) — substantial presence test *)
let meets_substantial_presence_test (days_current_year : int) (days_1st_preceding_year : int) (days_2nd_preceding_year : int) : bool =
  meets_31_day_requirement days_current_year &&
  meets_weighted_183_day_requirement days_current_year days_1st_preceding_year days_2nd_preceding_year

ocaml:
(* 7701(b)(3)(B): substantial presence test exception for individual present under 183 days in current year with closer connection to a foreign tax home *)
let has_closer_connection_exception
    (days_present_in_current_year : int)
    (has_foreign_tax_home_under_911d3 : bool)
    (has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country : bool) : bool =
  days_present_in_current_year < 183 &&
  has_foreign_tax_home_under_911d3 &&
  has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country

(* 7701(b)(3)(D): day not counted as present in US if exempt individual or medical-condition-based inability to leave *)
let is_excluded_presence_day (individual : person) (day : date) : bool =
  let is_exempt_individual_for_day = (* placeholder: exempt individual status under (b)(3)(D)(i) *) false in
  let unable_to_leave_due_to_medical_condition = (* placeholder: medical condition arose while present in US, (b)(3)(D)(ii) *) false in
  is_exempt_individual_for_day ||
  unable_to_leave_due_to_medical_condition

(* 7701(b)(3)(C): (B) exception blocked if individual sought lawful permanent resident status during current year *)
let blocks_closer_connection_exception
    (had_pending_adjustment_of_status_application : bool)
    (took_other_steps_to_apply_for_lawful_permanent_resident_status : bool) : bool =
  had_pending_adjustment_of_status_application ||
  took_other_steps_to_apply_for_lawful_permanent_resident_status

reason: Composes the (A) substantial presence day-count test with the (B) closer-connection exception gated by the (C) blocking condition, noting (D) operates upstream at day-count filtering.
ocaml:
(* 7701(b)(3): individual meets substantial presence test unless (B) closer-connection exception applies and is not blocked by (C) *)
let meets_substantial_presence_test_overall
    (days_current_year : int)
    (days_1st_preceding_year : int)
    (days_2nd_preceding_year : int)
    (has_foreign_tax_home_under_911d3 : bool)
    (has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country : bool)
    (had_pending_adjustment_of_status_application : bool)
    (took_other_steps_to_apply_for_lawful_permanent_resident_status : bool) : bool =
  let base_test = meets_substantial_presence_test days_current_year days_1st_preceding_year days_2nd_preceding_year in
  let exception_applies =
    has_closer_connection_exception days_current_year has_foreign_tax_home_under_911d3 has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country &&
    not (blocks_closer_connection_exception had_pending_adjustment_of_status_application took_other_steps_to_apply_for_lawful_permanent_resident_status)
  in
  base_test && not exception_applies
